about: What /keel:cleanup looks for and the thresholds it uses. Numbers come from a read-only measurement of ten real projects on 2026-10-11 (names and sizes only): a clean project has 0 safe items; an old tool folder collected about 140 one-off files in 3 months (about 10 a week, 1.2 MB in total); real data folders were 125 MB to 11 GB, the largest folder that was neither data nor dependencies 32 MB.

reminder.why: 20 safe files is about two weeks of leftovers at the measured pace; a clean project never reaches it. 100 MB catches one large dump (a log, a video) that a count would miss.
